representation.name: Logistic BMI PR AIC
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
infile <- args[[1]]
outfile <- args[[2]]

d <- read.delim(infile, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
needed <- c("Efficacy", "BMI")
missing_cols <- setdiff(needed, names(d))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}
fit_data <- d[!is.na(d$Efficacy) & !is.na(d$BMI), c("Efficacy", "BMI")]
fit_data$BMI <- as.numeric(fit_data$BMI)
fit_data <- fit_data[!is.na(fit_data$BMI), ]
fit_data$PR_event <- as.integer(fit_data$Efficacy == "PR")
if (length(unique(fit_data$PR_event)) < 2) {
  stop("Binary response has fewer than two observed classes after filtering")
}
model <- glm(PR_event ~ BMI, data = fit_data, family = binomial())
result <- data.frame(
  metric = c("AIC", "n", "events_PR", "non_events"),
  value = c(format(AIC(model), digits = 15, scientific = FALSE),
            as.character(nrow(fit_data)),
            as.character(sum(fit_data$PR_event == 1)),
            as.character(sum(fit_data$PR_event == 0)))
)
write.table(result, file = outfile, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RSCRIPT

set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_path <- args[[1]]
output_path <- args[[2]]

xml_unescape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub('<', '<', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('>', '>', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', '"', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(''', "'", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('&', '&', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

get_attr <- function(x, attr) {
  pat <- paste0(attr, '="([^"]*)"')
  m <- regexpr(pat, x, perl = TRUE)
  if (m[1] < 0) return(NA_character_)
  hit <- regmatches(x, m)
  sub(pat, '\\1', hit, perl = TRUE)
}

col_index <- function(ref) {
  letters <- gsub('[^A-Z]', '', ref)
  vals <- utf8ToInt(letters) - utf8ToInt('A') + 1L
  sum(vals * 26L ^ rev(seq_along(vals) - 1L))
}

read_file_one <- function(path) paste(readLines(path, warn = FALSE), collapse = '')

read_shared_strings <- function(root) {
  p <- file.path(root, 'xl', 'sharedStrings.xml')
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(character())
  xml <- read_file_one(p)
  sis <- regmatches(xml, gregexpr('<si[^>]*>.*?</si>', xml, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  vapply(sis, function(si) {
    ts <- regmatches(si, gregexpr('<t[^>]*>.*?</t>', si, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(ts) == 0L || identical(ts, character(0))) return('')
    txt <- gsub('^<t[^>]*>|</t>$', '', ts, perl = TRUE)
    xml_unescape(paste(txt, collapse = ''))
  }, character(1))
}

cell_value <- function(cell, shared) {
  typ <- get_attr(cell, 't')
  if (!is.na(typ) && typ == 'inlineStr') {
    ts <- regmatches(cell, gregexpr('<t[^>]*>.*?</t>', cell, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(ts) == 0L || identical(ts, character(0))) return(NA_character_)
    txt <- gsub('^<t[^>]*>|</t>$', '', ts, perl = TRUE)
    return(xml_unescape(paste(txt, collapse = '')))
  }
  m <- regexpr('<v[^>]*>.*?</v>', cell, perl = TRUE)
  if (m[1] < 0) return(NA_character_)
  raw <- regmatches(cell, m)
  val <- gsub('^<v[^>]*>|</v>$', '', raw, perl = TRUE)
  val <- xml_unescape(val)
  if (!is.na(typ) && typ == 's') return(shared[as.integer(val) + 1L])
  val
}

read_xlsx_first_sheet <- function(path) {
  root <- tempfile('xlsx_')
  dir.create(root)
  utils::unzip(path, exdir = root)
  sheet_paths <- sort(list.files(file.path(root, 'xl', 'worksheets'), pattern = '^sheet[0-9]+[.]xml$', full.names = TRUE))
  if (length(sheet_paths) < 1L) stop('No worksheet XML found')
  shared <- read_shared_strings(root)
  xml <- read_file_one(sheet_paths[1])
  row_xml <- regmatches(xml, gregexpr('<row[^>]*>.*?</row>', xml, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  rows <- list()
  max_col <- 0L
  for (row in row_xml) {
    row_tag <- regmatches(row, regexpr('^<row[^>]*>', row, perl = TRUE))
    r <- as.integer(get_attr(row_tag, 'r'))
    if (is.na(r)) next
    cells <- regmatches(row, gregexpr('<c[^>]*/>|<c[^>]*>.*?</c>', row, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(cells) == 0L || identical(cells, character(0))) next
    vals <- list()
    for (cell in cells) {
      ref <- get_attr(cell, 'r')
      if (is.na(ref)) next
      ci <- col_index(ref)
      vals[[as.character(ci)]] <- cell_value(cell, shared)
      if (ci > max_col) max_col <- ci
    }
    rows[[as.character(r)]] <- vals
  }
  if (length(rows) < 1L) stop('No worksheet rows parsed')
  max_row <- max(as.integer(names(rows)))
  mat <- matrix(NA_character_, nrow = max_row, ncol = max_col)
  for (rn in names(rows)) {
    for (cn in names(rows[[rn]])) mat[as.integer(rn), as.integer(cn)] <- rows[[rn]][[cn]]
  }
  headers <- mat[1, ]
  keep <- which(!is.na(headers) & nzchar(trimws(headers)))
  df <- as.data.frame(mat[-1, keep, drop = FALSE], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(df) <- make.names(headers[keep], unique = TRUE)
  attr(df, 'raw_headers') <- headers[keep]
  df
}

df <- read_xlsx_first_sheet(input_path)
raw_headers <- attr(df, 'raw_headers')
eff_col <- which(raw_headers == 'Efficacy')
bmi_col <- which(raw_headers == 'BMI')
if (length(eff_col) != 1L || length(bmi_col) != 1L) stop('Required Efficacy and BMI columns not found exactly once')

efficacy <- trimws(df[[eff_col]])
bmi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[bmi_col]]))
y <- ifelse(!is.na(efficacy) & toupper(efficacy) == 'PR', 1, ifelse(is.na(efficacy) | efficacy == '', NA, 0))
analysis_df <- data.frame(PR = y, BMI = bmi)
analysis_df <- analysis_df[complete.cases(analysis_df), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(analysis_df) == 0L) stop('No complete rows for model')
if (length(unique(analysis_df$PR)) != 2L) stop('Outcome does not contain both PR and non-PR classes')
fit <- glm(PR ~ BMI, family = binomial(), data = analysis_df)
result <- data.frame(
  metric = c('aic', 'n_complete', 'event_PR', 'non_event', 'coefficients', 'formula'),
  value = c(format(AIC(fit), digits = 17, scientific = FALSE),
            as.character(nrow(analysis_df)),
            as.character(sum(analysis_df$PR == 1)),
            as.character(sum(analysis_df$PR == 0)),
            paste(names(coef(fit)), format(coef(fit), digits = 17, scientific = FALSE), sep = '=', collapse = ';'),
            'glm(PR ~ BMI, family=binomial)')
)
write.table(result, file = output_path, sep = '\t', row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
RSCRIPT

xml_unescape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub('<', '<', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('>', '>', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', '"', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(''', "'", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('&', '&', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

get_attr <- function(x, attr) {
  pat <- paste0(attr, '="([^"]*)"')
  m <- regexpr(pat, x, perl = TRUE)
  if (m[1] < 0) return(NA_character_)
  hit <- regmatches(x, m)
  sub(pat, '\1', hit, perl = TRUE)
}

col_index <- function(ref) {
  letters <- gsub('[^A-Z]', '', ref)
  vals <- utf8ToInt(letters) - utf8ToInt('A') + 1L
  sum(vals * 26L ^ rev(seq_along(vals) - 1L))
}

read_file_one <- function(path) paste(readLines(path, warn = FALSE), collapse = '')

read_shared_strings <- function(root) {
  p <- file.path(root, 'xl', 'sharedStrings.xml')
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(character())
  xml <- read_file_one(p)
  sis <- regmatches(xml, gregexpr('<si[^>]*>.*?</si>', xml, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  vapply(sis, function(si) {
    ts <- regmatches(si, gregexpr('<t[^>]*>.*?</t>', si, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(ts) == 0L || identical(ts, character(0))) return('')
    txt <- gsub('^<t[^>]*>|</t>$', '', ts, perl = TRUE)
    xml_unescape(paste(txt, collapse = ''))
  }, character(1))
}

cell_value <- function(cell, shared) {
  typ <- get_attr(cell, 't')
  if (!is.na(typ) && typ == 'inlineStr') {
    ts <- regmatches(cell, gregexpr('<t[^>]*>.*?</t>', cell, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(ts) == 0L || identical(ts, character(0))) return(NA_character_)
    txt <- gsub('^<t[^>]*>|</t>$', '', ts, perl = TRUE)
    return(xml_unescape(paste(txt, collapse = '')))
  }
  m <- regexpr('<v[^>]*>.*?</v>', cell, perl = TRUE)
  if (m[1] < 0) return(NA_character_)
  raw <- regmatches(cell, m)
  val <- gsub('^<v[^>]*>|</v>$', '', raw, perl = TRUE)
  val <- xml_unescape(val)
  if (!is.na(typ) && typ == 's') return(shared[as.integer(val) + 1L])
  val
}

read_xlsx_first_sheet <- function(path) {
  root <- tempfile('xlsx_')
  dir.create(root)
  utils::unzip(path, exdir = root)
  sheet_paths <- sort(list.files(file.path(root, 'xl', 'worksheets'), pattern = '^sheet[0-9]+[.]xml$', full.names = TRUE))
  if (length(sheet_paths) < 1L) stop('No worksheet XML found')
  shared <- read_shared_strings(root)
  xml <- read_file_one(sheet_paths[1])
  row_xml <- regmatches(xml, gregexpr('<row[^>]*>.*?</row>', xml, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  rows <- list()
  max_col <- 0L
  for (row in row_xml) {
    row_tag <- regmatches(row, regexpr('^<row[^>]*>', row, perl = TRUE))
    r <- as.integer(get_attr(row_tag, 'r'))
    if (is.na(r)) next
    cells <- regmatches(row, gregexpr('<c[^>]*/>|<c[^>]*>.*?</c>', row, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(cells) == 0L || identical(cells, character(0))) next
    vals <- list()
    for (cell in cells) {
      ref <- get_attr(cell, 'r')
      if (is.na(ref)) next
      ci <- col_index(ref)
      vals[[as.character(ci)]] <- cell_value(cell, shared)
      if (ci > max_col) max_col <- ci
    }
    rows[[as.character(r)]] <- vals
  }
  if (length(rows) < 1L) stop('No worksheet rows parsed')
  max_row <- max(as.integer(names(rows)))
  mat <- matrix(NA_character_, nrow = max_row, ncol = max_col)
  for (rn in names(rows)) {
    for (cn in names(rows[[rn]])) mat[as.integer(rn), as.integer(cn)] <- rows[[rn]][[cn]]
  }
  headers <- mat[1, ]
  keep <- which(!is.na(headers) & nzchar(trimws(headers)))
  df <- as.data.frame(mat[-1, keep, drop = FALSE], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(df) <- make.names(headers[keep], unique = TRUE)
  attr(df, 'raw_headers') <- headers[keep]
  df
}

set -eu
cat > fit_aic.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_path <- args[[1]]
output_path <- args[[2]]

d <- read.delim(input_path, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE,
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
required <- c("Efficacy", "BMI")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(d))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}

efficacy <- trimws(as.character(d[["Efficacy"]]))
bmi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[["BMI"]]))
keep <- !is.na(efficacy) & efficacy != "" & !is.na(bmi)
fitdata <- data.frame(PR = as.integer(efficacy[keep] == "PR"), BMI = bmi[keep])
if (nrow(fitdata) == 0) stop("No complete Efficacy/BMI rows available")
if (length(unique(fitdata$PR)) < 2) stop("Binary response has fewer than two classes")

fit <- glm(PR ~ BMI, data = fitdata, family = binomial())
result <- data.frame(
  metric = c("AIC", "n", "event_PR", "non_event", "formula", "family"),
  value = c(format(AIC(fit), digits = 17),
            as.character(nrow(fitdata)),
            as.character(sum(fitdata$PR == 1)),
            as.character(sum(fitdata$PR == 0)),
            "PR_vs_nonPR ~ BMI",
            "binomial_logit"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(result, file = output_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT

def sigmoid(eta):
    if eta >= 0:
        z=exp(-eta)
        return 1.0/(1.0+z)
    z=exp(eta)
    return z/(1.0+z)

def log1pexp(eta):
    if eta > 0:
        return eta + log(1.0+exp(-eta))
    return log(1.0+exp(eta))

def loglik(b0,b1):
    return sum(y*(b0+b1*x) - log1pexp(b0+b1*x) for x,y in zip(xs,ys))

        p=sigmoid(eta)
        w=p*(1-p)
        diff=y-p
        g0 += diff
        g1 += diff*x
        a += w
        b += w*x
        c += w*x*x
    det=a*c-b*b
    d0=(c*g0-b*g1)/det

        new=loglik(nb0,nb1)

    if max(abs(step*d0), abs(step*d1)) < 1e-12:

        else:
            p=exp(eta)/(1.0+exp(eta))
            ll += y*eta - log(1.0+exp(eta))
        diff=y-p
        w=p*(1.0-p)
        g[0] += diff

        h[0][0] += w

        h[1][0] += w*x

representation.name: BMI logistic regression AIC
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_path <- args[[1]]
output_path <- args[[2]]

d <- read.delim(
  input_path,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = "",
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA")
)

required <- c("Efficacy", "BMI")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) {
  stop("Required columns Efficacy and BMI were not found")
}

efficacy <- trimws(as.character(d[["Efficacy"]]))
bmi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[["BMI"]]))
keep <- !is.na(efficacy) & efficacy %in% c("PR", "PD", "SD") & is.finite(bmi)
analysis_data <- data.frame(
  efficacy_PR = as.integer(efficacy[keep] == "PR"),
  BMI = bmi[keep]
)

if (nrow(analysis_data) == 0L || length(unique(analysis_data$efficacy_PR)) != 2L) {
  stop("No valid binary-response analysis set")
}

fit <- glm(
  efficacy_PR ~ BMI,
  data = analysis_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

report <- data.frame(
  metric = "AIC",
  value = format(AIC(fit), digits = 17, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
  n = nrow(analysis_data),
  events_PR = sum(analysis_data$efficacy_PR == 1L),
  nonevents_PD_SD = sum(analysis_data$efficacy_PR == 0L),
  formula = "efficacy_PR ~ BMI",
  family = "binomial",
  link = "logit",
  converged = isTRUE(fit$converged),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write.table(
  report,
  file = output_path,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = TRUE
)
RSCRIPT
Rscript analysis.R "$(inputs.input.path)" result.tsv

representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > fit.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
d <- read.delim(args[[1]], header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
required <- c("Efficacy", "BMI")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) stop("Required columns not found")
eff <- trimws(as.character(d[["Efficacy"]]))
bmi_text <- trimws(as.character(d[["BMI"]]))
keep <- nzchar(eff) & nzchar(bmi_text)
eff <- eff[keep]
bmi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(bmi_text[keep]))
if (anyNA(bmi)) stop("Non-numeric BMI in analysis rows")
allowed <- c("PR", "SD", "PD")
if (!all(eff %in% allowed)) stop("Unexpected efficacy category")
efficacy_pr <- as.integer(eff == "PR")
model_data <- data.frame(efficacy_pr = efficacy_pr, BMI = bmi)
fit <- glm(efficacy_pr ~ BMI, data = model_data, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
ll <- as.numeric(logLik(fit))
out <- data.frame(
  method = "unpenalized binomial GLM with logit link",
  formula = "I(Efficacy == PR) ~ BMI",
  non_event = "SD or PD",

def sigmoid(z):
    return 1/(1+math.exp(-z)) if z>=0 else math.exp(z)/(1+math.exp(z))
def ll(b0,b1):

representation.name: BMI-only PR Logistic Regression AIC
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > fit.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 1L) stop("Expected exactly one tabular input")
stopifnot(is.function(stats::glm))
dat0 <- utils::read.delim(
  args[[1]],
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = "",
  comment.char = "",
  check.names = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN")
)
needed <- c("Efficacy", "BMI")
if (!all(needed %in% names(dat0))) {
  stop(paste("Required columns missing:", paste(setdiff(needed, names(dat0)), collapse = ", ")))
}
eff <- trimws(as.character(dat0[["Efficacy"]]))
bmi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(dat0[["BMI"]])))
keep <- !is.na(eff) & nzchar(eff) & !is.na(bmi)
dat <- data.frame(
  PR = as.integer(eff[keep] == "PR"),
  BMI = bmi[keep]
)
if (nrow(dat) == 0L) stop("No complete Efficacy/BMI observations")
if (length(unique(dat$PR)) != 2L) stop("PR indicator does not contain both classes")
fit <- stats::glm(PR ~ BMI, data = dat, family = stats::binomial(link = "logit"))
aic <- as.numeric(stats::AIC(fit))
out <- data.frame(
  metric = c("AIC", "n_complete", "n_PR", "formula", "family", "response_event", "predictor"),
  value = c(
    format(aic, digits = 17, scientific = TRUE),
    as.character(nrow(dat)),
    as.character(sum(dat$PR == 1L)),
    "PR ~ BMI",
    "binomial(link=logit)",
    "Efficacy == PR",
    "BMI"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
utils::write.table(out, file = "result.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript fit.R "$(inputs.input.path)"

representation.shell_command:
set -eu
python - "$(inputs.input.path)" > aic.tsv <<'PY'
import re
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm

if not getattr(statsmodels, "__version__", ""):
    raise RuntimeError("statsmodels import/version check failed")

input_path = sys.argv[1]
main_ns = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
ns = {"m": main_ns}

def column_index(cell_ref):
    letters = re.match(r"[A-Z]+", cell_ref).group(0)
    idx = 0
    for ch in letters:
        idx = idx * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
    return idx - 1

with zipfile.ZipFile(input_path, "r") as workbook:
    shared_root = ET.fromstring(workbook.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
    shared_strings = []
    for si in shared_root.findall("m:si", ns):
        shared_strings.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{%s}t" % main_ns)))

    sheet_root = ET.fromstring(workbook.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))
    sheet_rows = {}
    for row in sheet_root.findall(".//m:sheetData/m:row", ns):
        row_number = int(row.get("r"))
        values = {}
        for cell in row.findall("m:c", ns):
            value_node = cell.find("m:v", ns)
            if value_node is None or value_node.text is None:
                value = None
            elif cell.get("t") == "s":
                value = shared_strings[int(value_node.text)]
            else:
                value = value_node.text
            values[column_index(cell.get("r"))] = value
        sheet_rows[row_number] = values

header = sheet_rows.get(1, {})
header_names = {value: idx for idx, value in header.items() if value is not None}
if "Efficacy" not in header_names or "BMI" not in header_names:
    raise RuntimeError("Required Efficacy and BMI headers were not found")
efficacy_col = header_names["Efficacy"]
bmi_col = header_names["BMI"]

records = []
rows_seen = 0
rows_excluded = 0
for row_number in sorted(k for k in sheet_rows if k > 1):
    row = sheet_rows[row_number]
    efficacy = row.get(efficacy_col)
    bmi_raw = row.get(bmi_col)
    if efficacy is None and bmi_raw is None:
        continue
    rows_seen += 1
    if efficacy is None or bmi_raw is None or str(bmi_raw).strip() == "":
        rows_excluded += 1
        continue
    if efficacy not in ("PR", "SD", "PD"):
        raise RuntimeError("Unexpected efficacy category: %r" % (efficacy,))
    records.append((1 if efficacy == "PR" else 0, float(bmi_raw)))

if not records:
    raise RuntimeError("No complete Efficacy/BMI observations were found")
y = np.asarray([r[0] for r in records], dtype=float)
bmi = np.asarray([r[1] for r in records], dtype=float)
X = sm.add_constant(bmi, has_constant="add")
result = sm.Logit(y, X).fit(disp=False, maxiter=200)

print("metric\tvalue")
print("AIC\t%.17g" % float(result.aic))
print("response\tPR_vs_nonPR")
print("predictor\tBMI")
print("model\tLogit(PR==1) ~ 1 + BMI")
print("n_rows_seen\t%d" % rows_seen)
print("n_rows_used\t%d" % int(result.nobs))
print("n_rows_excluded\t%d" % rows_excluded)
print("log_likelihood\t%.17g" % float(result.llf))
print("parameter_count\t%d" % len(result.params))
PY

        sheet_rows[row_number] = values

    raise RuntimeError("Required Efficacy and BMI headers were not found")
efficacy_col = header_names["Efficacy"]
bmi_col = header_names["BMI"]

records = []

rows_excluded = 0
for row_number in sorted(k for k in sheet_rows if k > 1):
    row = sheet_rows[row_number]

    bmi_raw = row.get(bmi_col)

import math
import re
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm

NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
CELL_RE = re.compile(r"^([A-Z]+)([0-9]+)$")

def cell_value(cell, shared):
    kind = cell.attrib.get("t")
    if kind == "inlineStr":
        return "".join((node.text or "") for node in cell.iter(f"{{{NS}}}t"))
    value_node = cell.find(f"{{{NS}}}v")
    if value_node is None:
        return None
    raw = value_node.text
    if kind == "s":
        return shared[int(raw)]
    if kind == "b":
        return raw == "1"
    return raw

def read_rows(path):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as workbook:
        shared = []
        if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in workbook.namelist():
            root = ET.fromstring(workbook.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
            for item in root.findall(f"{{{NS}}}si"):
                shared.append("".join((node.text or "") for node in item.iter(f"{{{NS}}}t")))
        sheet = ET.fromstring(workbook.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))
        rows = {}
        for row in sheet.findall(f".//{{{NS}}}row"):
            row_number = int(row.attrib["r"])
            values = {}
            for cell in row.findall(f"{{{NS}}}c"):
                ref = cell.attrib["r"]
                col = re.match(r"^([A-Z]+)", ref).group(1)
                values[col] = cell_value(cell, shared)
            if values:
                rows[row_number] = values
        return rows

def main():
    rows = read_rows(sys.argv[1])
    header = rows.get(1, {})
    by_name = {str(value).strip(): col for col, value in header.items() if value is not None}
    if "Efficacy" not in by_name or "BMI" not in by_name:
        raise RuntimeError("required Efficacy and BMI columns are missing")
    efficacy_col = by_name["Efficacy"]
    bmi_col = by_name["BMI"]
    x_values = []
    y_values = []
    for row_number in sorted(rows):
        if row_number == 1:
            continue
        row = rows[row_number]
        if row.get("A") in (None, ""):
            continue
        efficacy = row.get(efficacy_col)
        bmi = row.get(bmi_col)
        if efficacy in (None, "") or bmi in (None, ""):
            continue
        try:
            bmi_value = float(bmi)
        except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(f"non-numeric BMI at worksheet row {row_number}") from exc
        x_values.append(bmi_value)
        y_values.append(1.0 if str(efficacy).strip().upper() == "PR" else 0.0)
    if not x_values or len(set(y_values)) != 2:
        raise RuntimeError("invalid complete-case PR indicator")
    design = sm.add_constant(np.asarray(x_values, dtype=float), has_constant="add")
    fitted = sm.GLM(
        np.asarray(y_values, dtype=float),
        design,
        family=sm.families.Binomial(),
    ).fit()
    aic = float(fitted.aic)
    if not math.isfinite(aic):
        raise RuntimeError("fitted AIC is not finite")
    pr_count = int(sum(y_values))
    with open("result.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as output:
        output.write("metric\tvalue\n")
        output.write(f"aic\t{aic:.17g}\n")
        output.write(f"effective_n\t{len(y_values)}\n")
        output.write(f"pr_count\t{pr_count}\n")
        output.write(f"non_pr_count\t{len(y_values) - pr_count}\n")
        output.write("model\tBinomial logistic regression: PR indicator ~ BMI\n")
        output.write(f"statsmodels_version\t{sm.__version__}\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from math import exp, log, isfinite
p='inputs/data.xlsx'
ws=load_workbook(p,data_only=True,read_only=True).active
obs=[]
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2,max_col=12,values_only=True):
    efficacy=row[2]
    bmi=row[10]
    if efficacy is None:
        continue
    if not isinstance(bmi,(int,float)):
        raise ValueError(('nonnumeric BMI',row))
    y=1.0 if efficacy=='PR' else 0.0
    obs.append((float(bmi),y,efficacy))
print('n',len(obs),'y1',sum(y for x,y,e in obs),'y0',sum(1-y for x,y,e in obs))
print('BMI range',min(x for x,y,e in obs),max(x for x,y,e in obs))

def sigmoid(z):
    if z>=0:
        ez=exp(-z)
        return 1/(1+ez)
    ez=exp(z)
    return ez/(1+ez)

def log1pexp(z):
    if z>0: return z+log1p(exp(-z))
    return log1p(exp(z))
from math import log1p
b0=0.0;b1=0.0
for it in range(100):
    g0=g1=0.0
    # negative Hessian information entries
    h00=h01=h11=0.0
    ll=0.0
    for x,y,e in obs:
        z=b0+b1*x
        p=sigmoid(z)
        g0 += y-p
        g1 += x*(y-p)
        w=p*(1-p)
        h00 += w
        h01 += x*w
        h11 += x*x*w
        ll += y*z-log1pexp(z)
    det=h00*h11-h01*h01
    # solve H * step = gradient where H is information (negative log-likelihood Hessian), Newton b += H"'^-1 grad
    d0=(h11*g0-h01*g1)/det
    d1=(-h01*g0+h00*g1)/det
    # line search ensure ll increase
    step=1.0
    old=(b0,b1,ll)
    while step>1e-12:
        nb0=b0+step*d0;nb1=b1+step*d1
        nll=sum(y*(nb0+nb1*x)-log1pexp(nb0+nb1*x) for x,y,e in obs)
        if nll>=ll:
            b0,b1,ll=nb0,nb1,nll
            break
        step*=0.5
    if it<10 or it%10==0:
        print(it,'"'b',b0,b1,'ll',ll,'g',g0,g1,'d',d0,d1,'step',step)
    if max(abs(step*d0),abs(step*d1))<1e-14:
        print('converged',it)
        break
print('coef',repr(b0),repr(b1))
print('logLik',repr(ll),'AIC',repr(4-2*ll))
# compute null AIC too
p0=sum(y for x,y,e in obs)/len(obs)
ll0=sum(y*log(p0)+(1-y)*log(1-p0) for x,y,e in obs)
print('null',repr(ll0),'AIC',repr(2-2*ll0),'LR',repr(2*(ll-ll0)))

import math
# Parse and verify AIC manually with a Newton/optimization fallback
from openpyxl import load_workbook
import statsmodels.api as sm, numpy as np, pandas as pd
wb=load_workbook('/workspace/inputs/data.xlsx', data_only=True)
ws=wb['Sheet1']
data=[]
for r in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    if r[0] is None: continue
    data.append(r)
df=pd.DataFrame(data, columns=['seq','Groups','Efficacy','Age','Family history','ECOG-PS','Child-Pugh','Chemotherapy experience','HBV infection','Gender','BMI','Toxic'])
y=(df.Efficacy=='PR').astype(float).to_numpy()
x=df.BMI.astype(float).to_numpy()
# simple coordinate optim
b0,b1=-3.631934,0.167746
for _ in range(100):
    eta=b0+b1*x
    p=1/(1+np.exp(-eta))
    res=y-p
    g0=res.sum(); g1=(res*x).sum()
    w=p*(1-p)
    H00=w.sum(); H01=(w*x).sum(); H11=(w*x*x).sum()
    det=H00*H11-H01**2
    db0=(H11*g0-H01*g1)/det
    db1=(-H01*g0+H00*g1)/det
    b0+=db0; b1+=db1
    if max(abs(db0),abs(db1))<1e-12: break
eta=b0+b1*x
p=1/(1+np.exp(-eta))
ll=np.sum(y*np.log(p)+(1-y)*np.log(1-p))
print(b0,b1,ll,-2*ll+2*2)

    if eff in ('PR','SD','PD') and bmi is not None:
        y.append(1 if eff=='PR' else 0)
        x.append(float(bmi))
print(len(y), sum(y), sum(1 for v in y if v==0), min(x), max(x))
# MLE newton
n=len(y)
b0=0.0; b1=0.0
for it in range(100):
    # compute p, gradient hessian
    grad0=0; grad1=0; h00=0; h01=0; h11=0; ll=0
    for yi, xi in zip(y,x):
        eta=b0+b1*xi
        # p logistic stable
        if eta>=0:
            p=1/(1+math.exp(-eta))
        else:
            e=math.exp(eta); p=e/(1+e)
        # clip p
        p=max(1e-15,min(1-1e-15,p))
        # ll contribution
        ll += yi*math.log(p)+(1-yi)*math.log(1-p)
        d=yi-p
        grad0 += d
        grad1 += d*xi
        w=p*(1-p)
        h00 += w
        h01 += w*xi
        h11 += w*xi*xi
    # solve 2x2 Hessian invert
    det=h00*h11-h01*h01
    if abs(det)<1e-15:
        break
    db0=(h11*grad0-h01*grad1)/det
    db1=(-h01*grad0+h00*grad1)/det
    b0 += db0; b1 += db1
    if max(abs(db0),abs(db1))<1e-12:
        print('converged',it)
        break
# recompute final ll
ll=0
for yi,xi in zip(y,x):
    eta=b0+b1*xi
    if eta>=0: p=1/(1+math.exp(-eta))
    else: e=math.exp(eta); p=e/(1+e)
    p=max(1e-15,min(1-1e-15,p))
    ll += yi*math.log(p)+(1-yi)*math.log(1-p)
k=2
aic=-2*ll+2*k
print('b0,b1',b0,b1)
print('ll',ll)
print('AIC',aic)
# null ll for reference
p0=sum(y)/n
ll0=sum(y)*math.log(p0)+sum(1-yi for yi in y)*math.log(1-p0)
print('null ll', ll0, 'null AIC',-2*ll0+2)
print('deviance', -2*ll, 2*(ll-ll0))

from scipy.optimize import minimize

# no intercept variant just for info

import bioblend.galaxy, requests, io, openpyxl

api_key = open("/run/secrets/galaxy_api_key").read().strip()
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url="https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)

hist_id = "bbd44e69cb8906b509a9d6fc10245ae7"
dataset_id = "f9cad7b01a47213537ac13c9f9bc58b1"

url = f"https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories/{hist_id}/contents/{dataset_id}/display"
headers = {"x-api-key": api_key}
r = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(io.BytesIO(r.content))
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Get all data
data = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
headers_row = data[0]
rows = data[1:]

print("Headers:", headers_row[:12])
print(f"Total data rows: {len(rows)}")

# Unique values in Efficacy
efficacy_vals = set()
groups_vals = set()
for row in rows:
    efficacy_vals.add(row[2])
    groups_vals.add(row[1])

print(f"Efficacy unique values: {efficacy_vals}")
print(f"Groups unique values: {groups_vals}")

# Counts
from collections import Counter
eff_counts = Counter(row[2] for row in rows)
print(f"Efficacy counts: {eff_counts}")

# Check BMI for any missing
bmi_vals = [row[10] for row in rows]
missing_bmi = sum(1 for b in bmi_vals if b is None)
print(f"Missing BMI values: {missing_bmi}")
print(f"BMI range: {min(b for b in bmi_vals if b is not None)} - {max(b for b in bmi_vals if b is not None)}")
PYEOF

import bioblend.galaxy, requests, io, openpyxl

api_key = open("/run/secrets/galaxy_api_key").read().strip()
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url="https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)

hist_id = "bbd44e69cb8906b509a9d6fc10245ae7"
dataset_id = "f9cad7b01a47213537ac13c9f9bc58b1"

url = f"https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories/{hist_id}/contents/{dataset_id}/display"
headers = {"x-api-key": api_key}
r = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(io.BytesIO(r.content))
ws = wb['Sheet1']

data = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
rows = data[1:]

# Show rows with None efficacy
none_rows = [(i, r) for i, r in enumerate(rows) if r[2] is None]
print(f"Rows with None efficacy: {len(none_rows)}")
for i, r in none_rows[:5]:
    print(f"  Row {i+2}: seq={r[0]}, groups={r[1]}, efficacy={r[2]}, bmi={r[10]}")

# Show rows with Groups=2
g2_rows = [(i, r) for i, r in enumerate(rows) if r[1] == 2]
print(f"\nRows with Groups=2: {len(g2_rows)}")
for i, r in g2_rows[:5]:
    print(f"  Row {i+2}: seq={r[0]}, groups={r[1]}, efficacy={r[2]}, bmi={r[10]}")

# Groups=1 rows
g1_rows = [(i, r) for i, r in enumerate(rows) if r[1] == 1]
print(f"\nRows with Groups=1: {len(g1_rows)}")
for i, r in g1_rows[:5]:
    print(f"  Row {i+2}: seq={r[0]}, groups={r[1]}, efficacy={r[2]}, bmi={r[10]}")

# See the gap - where does Groups switch?
print("\nFirst 50 rows groups values:")
for i in range(50):
    r = rows[i]
    print(f"  Row {i+2}: groups={r[1]}, efficacy={r[2]}, bmi={r[10]}")

# Last 10 rows
print("\nLast 10 rows:")
for i in range(len(rows)-10, len(rows)):
    r = rows[i]
    print(f"  Row {i+2}: groups={r[1]}, efficacy={r[2]}, bmi={r[10]}")

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/data.xlsx', data_only=True)

# Get all efficacy values (column C, index 2) to understand response categories
efficacy_vals = set()
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    efficacy_vals.add(row[2])

print(f"Efficacy values: {efficacy_vals}")

# Count of each efficacy value
from collections import Counter
efficacy_counts = Counter()
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    efficacy_counts[row[2]] += 1
print(f"Efficacy counts: {efficacy_counts}")

# Print last 20 rows
print("\nLast 20 rows:")
for row_idx, row in enumerate(ws.iter_rows(min_row=max(1, ws.max_row-19), max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True), ws.max_row-19):
    print(f"Row {row_idx}: {list(row[:12])}")

print(f"BMI type: {type(bmi_vals[0])}")
print(f"Missing BMI count: {sum(1 for b in bmi_vals if b is None)}")

import bioblend.galaxy
import json

api_key = "[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]"
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url="https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)

hist_id = "bbd44e69cb8906b54b65f49208887b74"

representation = {
    "class": "GalaxyUserTool",
    "id": "logistic-regression-aic-v1",
    "name": "Logistic Regression AIC",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "container": "quay.io/biocontainers/r-base:4.4.1",
    "shell_command": """set -eu
Rscript - "$(inputs.input.path)" << 'REOF'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
data <- read.table(args[1], header=TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
data <- data[!is.na(data$BMI) & !is.na(data$Efficacy) & data$Efficacy != "", ]
data$PR <- ifelse(data$Efficacy == "PR", 1, 0)
model <- glm(PR ~ BMI, data = data, family = binomial)
aic_val <- AIC(model)
write.table(data.frame(AIC = aic_val), "aic_result.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
REOF
""",
    "inputs": [
        {

import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

data = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1], sep="\\t")
# Keep rows with known efficacy outcome and valid BMI
data = data[data["Efficacy"].isin(["PR", "SD", "PD"])]
data = data.dropna(subset=["BMI"])
# Binary outcome: PR = 1, SD/PD = 0
data["responder"] = (data["Efficacy"] == "PR").astype(int)

# Prepare design matrix and response
X = sm.add_constant(data["BMI"].astype(float))
y = data["responder"]

# Fit logistic regression
model = sm.Logit(y, X)
result = model.fit(disp=False)

df <- read.csv("/tmp/data.csv", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
df$response <- ifelse(df$Efficacy == "PR", 1, 0)

# Verify data
cat("Total rows:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("PR count:", sum(df$response==1), "\n")
cat("non-PR count:", sum(df$response==0), "\n")

# Check for any missing BMI
cat("Missing BMI:", sum(is.na(df$BMI)), "\n")

# Fit model
model <- glm(response ~ BMI, data = df, family = binomial)

# Get exact values
cat("\nLog-likelihood:", as.numeric(logLik(model)), "\n")
cat("AIC:", AIC(model), "\n")
cat("AIC (model\$aic):", model$aic, "\n")
cat("Residual deviance:", model$deviance, "\n")
cat("Null deviance:", model$null.deviance, "\n")
cat("df residual:", model$df.residual, "\n")
cat("df null:", model$df.null, "\n")

# Manual AIC computation
n_params <- length(coef(model))
manual_aic <- -2 * as.numeric(logLik(model)) + 2 * n_params
cat("\nManual AIC:", manual_aic, "\n")

# Also verify with deviance
cat("AIC from deviance:", model$deviance + 2*n_params, "\n")

# Check model convergence
cat("\nConverged:", model$converged, "\n")
cat("Number of iterations:", model$iter, "\n")
' 2>&1

import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('inputs/data.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

rows = list(ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True))

# Check alignment of missing values
eff_missing = [i for i, r in enumerate(rows) if r[2] is None]
bmi_missing = [i for i, r in enumerate(rows) if r[10] is None]
print(f'Rows with missing efficacy: {len(eff_missing)}')
print(f'Rows with missing BMI: {len(bmi_missing)}')
print(f'Intersection: {len(set(eff_missing) & set(bmi_missing))}')
print(f'eff missing indices: {eff_missing}')
print(f'bmi missing indices: {bmi_missing}')

# Check how many have both non-missing
both_present = [(i, r) for i, r in enumerate(rows) if r[2] is not None and r[10] is not None]
print(f'Rows with both efficacy and BMI present: {len(both_present)}')
for i, r in both_present:
    print(f'  Row {i+2}: efficacy={r[2]}, BMI={r[10]}')

# Create the analysis dataset
eff_map = {'PR': 1, 'SD': 0, 'PD': 0}
y = []
bmi = []
for r in rows:
    if r[2] is not None and r[10] is not None:
        y.append(eff_map[r[2]])
        bmi.append(r[10])

print(f'\nAnalysis dataset: {len(y)} rows')
print(f'PR=1: {sum(y)}, Non-PR=0: {len(y)-sum(y)}')
"

import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Data
eff_map = {'PR': 1, 'SD': 0, 'PD': 0}

import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('inputs/data.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

y = []
bmi = []
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    if row[2] is not None and row[10] is not None:
        y.append(eff_map[row[2]])
        bmi.append(row[10])

y = np.array(y)
X = sm.add_constant(np.array(bmi))

# Fit logistic regression
model = sm.Logit(y, X)
result = model.fit(disp=0)
print(result.summary())
print()
print(f'AIC: {result.aic}')
"

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Read data
df = pd.read_excel('inputs/data.xlsx')
print('Columns:', list(df.columns))
print('Shape:', df.shape)

# Relevant columns
print('BMI column:', df.columns[10])

df_model['response'] = (df_model['Efficacy'] == 'PR').astype(int)
print('Response distribution:', df_model['response'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Add intercept
X = sm.add_constant(df_model['BMI'])
y = df_model['response']

# Fit logistic regression
model = sm.Logit(y, X)
result = model.fit(disp=0)

print(f'AIC: {result.aic:.6f}')
print(f'LLF: {result.llf:.6f}')
print(f'Params: {result.params.values}')
print(result.summary())

import numpy as np
from scipy.special import expit  # sigmoid
from scipy.optimize import minimize

# Read data manually
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('inputs/data.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']

bmi_list = []
pr_list = []
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    bmi = row[10]
    eff = row[2]
    if bmi is not None:
        bmi_list.append(float(bmi))
        pr_list.append(1.0 if eff == 'PR' else 0.0)

X = np.array(bmi_list)
y = np.array(pr_list)
n = len(y)

# Add intercept
X_design = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), X])

# Negative log-likelihood for logistic regression
def neg_ll(beta):
    eta = X_design @ beta
    p = expit(eta)
    # Avoid log(0)
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    ll = np.sum(y * np.log(p) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - p))
    return -ll

# Initial guess
beta0 = np.zeros(2)
result = minimize(neg_ll, beta0, method='BFGS')
beta_hat = result.x
ll_max = -result.fun  # log-likelihood at MLE
k = 2  # number of parameters
aic = 2 * k - 2 * ll_max

print(f'Beta: {beta_hat}')
print(f'Log-likelihood: {ll_max}')
print(f'AIC: {aic}')
print(f'k: {k}')
print(f'n: {n}')
"
